name: Chattering Staff of Skulls

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-5-magic-items. Mechanics checked against the chapter. Prices use the existing rarity convention, not book-specific prices; unspecified weights use 0, and templates inherit base-item weight.

summary: Chill Touch, Advantage on Intimidation, a dim glow, and a Reaction that gives an attack Disadvantage.
text: While holding this staff you can cast Chill Touch with it using your spell attack bonus, you have Advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks, and it sheds Dim Light in a 5-foot radius. When a creature you can see within 30 feet makes an attack roll, you can take a Reaction to make the skulls shriek: the attack has Disadvantage.
